This is not an intentional transition—it persists across all held frames (large, portrait, and light-background). The light-background frame (4th image) confirms the same clipping occurs regardless of background, indicating a layout or masking error, not a contrast issue. The frame-difference metrics (mean 0.028, max 0.071) suggest minimal motion, consistent with static or near-static text blocks, but do not mitigate the persistent visual defect. The design lacks spectacle beyond a simple color highlight on one word; there is no transformation, depth, or memorable payoff. Originality is low; the effect resembles a basic karaoke-style highlight with no distinctive combination of decisions.
critical_issues: Persistent clipping of top and bottom lyric lines across all frames and orientations, rendering them illegible and violating the 'no unintended clipping' requirement.
